modifiers.note: Authored tuning, not historical rates. Positive edge improves intimidation, aim and escape. Experience also gives a smaller bonus to going unnoticed; party condition never does.

reports.note: Authored tuning. Word of an incident leaves with its living local witnesses' contacts after a short delay and travels along the road with other parties and traders in both directions. Not a measured historical rate.

kansas_river.title: The ferry landing
kansas_river.note: An authored encounter with a ferry crew, not a reconstruction of the Papin family or their Kanza relatives. A ferry taken from its crew must be worked by the party, with a higher mishap risk than a crewed crossing.

fort_laramie.title: The trading store
fort_laramie.note: An authored encounter at the private adobe trading post, then still Fort John. A larger staff than the western posts; not a reconstruction of named traders or a garrison.

fort_bridger.title: The trading store
fort_bridger.note: An authored encounter at the private trading establishment, not a reconstruction of a named historical keeper or an army garrison.

fort_hall.title: The trading store
fort_hall.note: An authored encounter at the Hudson's Bay Company post, not a reconstruction of a named officer or an army garrison.

fort_boise.title: The trading store
fort_boise.note: An authored encounter at the small Hudson's Bay Company post, not a reconstruction of a named officer or the later military fort.

barlow_pass.title: The toll gate
barlow_pass.note: An authored encounter at the Barlow Road toll gate, not a reconstruction of a named gatekeeper. Getting the wagons through without paying waives the toll.
